<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:10">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ</cite> <he>שרון מטפחין ומְרַקְּדִין</he> (not <he>ומרקדקין</he>) they began to clap and dance.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:2">Koh. R. to III, 2</cite> <he>לית … עד דאת מְרַקֵּיד וכ׳</he> thou shalt not move from here, until thou dancest a little for us.
